notes.title: 1.0.11 ( balances )
notes.content:
[h2]changes[/h2]

[h3]balances[/h3]
Improved button leniency on certain advanced techniques.
[list]
[*] input for entering [spoiler]ball[/spoiler] is now 33% more lenient, ( +5 frames )
[*] you can now buffer [spoiler]ball input[/spoiler] from charging, so you can essentially queue a [spoiler]ball[/spoiler] from a charge as long as you hold.
[*] because of this, [spoiler]a certain unintended technique[/spoiler] is easier, and is nerfed when performed this way.
[*] however, if done the old way, it will still retain the old properties.
[*] input for [spoiler]sliding[/spoiler] is 25% more lenient (+2 frames)
[*] adjusted final scoring values
[/list]

[h3]level changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] added telescope to the [spoiler]final area[/spoiler]
[*] slightly moved [spoiler]activation zone of final challenge[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3]bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Corrected final scoring to reflect active time of entry and score correctly
[*] Fixed corners eating all momentum with [spoiler]ball[/spoiler]
[/list]

It seems like most of the bugs are squashed! Finally stable...

Thank you for all the reports and feedback and enjoying the game, hope you have a good new year!!

notes.title: progress progress
notes.content:
ceroro here yes

this is an update, but more of a ramble. Thats your warning!

Its already been 4 months since I put the game page on steam, 8 months since I started! I have been steadily working on finishing it ASAP! I am pretty tired of working nonstop on bat to the heavens for months and months straight, I'm going a lil crazy! ( I do think you have to be a lil crazy to do solo gamedev regardless...)

Here are some of the things that have happened and are left to be done!

[h2]PROGRESS!![/h2]
[list]
[*] progress is about like... 95% done, seriously!
[*] Mainly some music, sprites, and art to be done but the base is pretty much there!
[*] all levels done, puzzles tested, fixed, cheese prevention!!!
[*] so many sound effects. so many.
[*] We finally have our first completion from playtesters! ( game is hard , ending was in only recently!)
[*] Tons and tons of secrets have been put in the game... will anyone find them all? ( will anyone bother?)
[*] Some polish and refining to be done...
[*] File cleanup as well, and maybe final optimizations...
[*] lots of stress accumulation on release timing... 
[*] my brain is thinking of next game idea... stop it brain
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078151/beec269aa9a81a3042d872a0ea3102e25ca04dd0.png[/img]
yaaay ( npc reveal )

[h2]RAMBLING!![/h2]
Making a game is so stressful cause of how much work and effort I put into it before releasing, and I still have to worry about marketing, which I really don't want to do any, honestly!! I want to let the game speak for itself!! Its a hard game so I'm also worried that will scare off people or give a bad impression... But I'll stick true to the core design and make sure its hard and rewarding!! ( maybe its cause ive been playing it for so long!! )

At this point, I better just stop worrying and just finish and release it and not think about it any further!! (except for bugfixes)

Now that my brain is like half thinking of next game though, scope and content creep SHOULD stop ( but it prob won't ).
When you put one new thing, you gotta consider sounds for it, art for it, maybe music, maybe unique interactions, anything the player could think of... It becomes a headache later on very quickly!!

But I'd say the more content a game has the more people can enjoy it (even if they might never see it)!!
[i]Honestly I still can't estimate the playtime, and don't want to give false estimates, but, its a lot longer than I had intended![/i]
I'm excited... and scared to see people play my game!!

[h2]wrapup[/h2]
This has truly been a cerothoughts(tm) blogpost instead of a #professionalgamedevupdate, but hopefully once the last few things are done I can set a release date!! I want to aim for before the end of this year, and if I keep working hard and don't be stuck with perfectionism, it should happen. Hype!!

for my next game I'm definitely taking it easier!!

ty 4 reading wah
